-----Mensaje original-----
De: Distance Development [mailto:dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk]=20
Enviado el: Lunes, 12 de Junio de 2006 01:27 a.m.
Para: Natalia Quinteros
Asunto: Re: [DIST-SAMP] cancel census

Natalia,

Perhaps I didn't understand your question correctly. If a survey is
cancelled=20
then you can't pretend it was done! Perhaps your context is multiple
surveys=20
of the same transects? In that case, it is still ok to use the transect =
-
you=20
just need to adjust the survey effort. For example, if you have 10 line=20
transects of 2km long, and you surveyed each one 4 times then you would
enter=20
the data into distance as 10 lines each of 2x4=3D8km long. If, however, =
you=20
missed one visit to one transect because of rain you would enter that
transect=20
as being 6km long. Does this help?

Once this is all sorted out, I'd be grateful if you would post a summary =
of=20
the responses back to the list.

Cheers,

- len

On Tue, 6 Jun 2006 21:57:15 -0500, Natalia Quinteros wrote:

> >Dear List,

> >I was checking my data and I realized I had several census canceled beca=
use
> >the rain. I would like to know if I can use this data for the analysis,
> >because I have more observations that can increase my small sample.

> >Bests,

> >Natalia
